Card Q&A.a: The top card is returned to the hand and all of the cards under it are trashed.
Card Q&A.q: I used this card's [When Attacking] effect to play a Digimon card with [Angoramon] in its text. What happens if it digivolves and has a card on top of it at the end of my opponent's turn?

Effect: {Hand} [Counter] ＜Blast Digivolve＞ (One of your Digimon may digivolve into this card without paying the cost.)
[On Play] [When Digivolving] Suspend 1 of your opponent's Digimon. Then, if they have no unsuspended Digimon, gain 2 memory.
[When Attacking] You may play 1 Digimon card with [Angoramon] in its text from your hand without paying the cost. At the end of your opponent’s turn, return that Digimon to the hand.
Special Rule: ＜Overflow (-4)＞ (As this card moves from the battle area or under a card to another area, lose 4 memory.)
